title: The Photograph — EN/ES/FR (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational 96bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal life philosophy Spanish French language learning family Zimbabwe Perth memory
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The photograph has no smell and that's the thing that's missing
From the complete record of the moment — all the hissing
Of the cicadas and the exact temperature of the July
Are not in the photograph — just the faces and the sky

[Verse 2 — Spanish, with English translation]
La fotografía no tiene olor y eso es lo que falta
[The photograph has no smell and that's what is missing]
Del registro completo del momento — la alta
[From the complete record of the moment — the high]
El sonido de los grillos y la temperatura exacta de julio
[The sound of the crickets and the exact temperature of July]
No están en la fotografía — solo los rostros y el preludio
[Are not in the photograph — only the faces and the prelude]

[Chorus — English]
The photograph knows something I don't know
It knows the faces but not the conversation below
The photograph keeps the light of that day exactly
But nothing of what was said or felt — that's the impactly
That's my boy

[Bridge — French, with English translation]
La photographie n'a pas d'odeur et c'est ce qui manque
[The photograph has no smell and that's what's missing]
Du registre complet du moment — la plaque
[From the complete record of the moment — the plate]
Le bruit des cigales et la température exacte de juillet
[The sound of the cicadas and the exact temperature of July]
Ne sont pas dans la photo — juste les visages et le guet
[Are not in the photo — just the faces and the watch]

[Outro — All three languages]
Photograph knows the face… La fotografía conoce el rostro… La photo connaît le visage
Not the smell, not the sound — No el olor, no el sonido — Pas l'odeur, pas le son
The gardens still growing
